cold_start.definition: fresh CKS process; Ollama model resident; report daemon/model cold load separately without unloading a user model

order: Rotate fixed eight-arm order once per repetition; same prompt/filter/K/model on paired arms. No concurrent latency trials.

uncertainty.resampling_unit: paired independent question or fixture family; cluster language/state variants within a family; never repeated runs
uncertainty.small_group_policy: n<10 independent final questions in an important group => descriptive/inconclusive; no default-on or release claim. Expansion requires new pre-result review.

v1_vs_v2: Keep v1 citation metrics, v2 evidence coordinate/semantic states and human claim verdicts separate. An abstained answer can still cite evidence of absence; expect_no_citations is a separate stricter v1 oracle.
limitations: 8 static final questions are too small for subgroup release inference.
Executable adapters for separate concept-text and relation arms and budget injection are still required.
No final fixture has been executed. Source/query drafts do not imply approval of semantic facts.
